title: preorder
description: A set carrying a relation ≤ that is reflexive and transitive but not antisymmetric — the weakest comparison, allowing ties. The accessibility frame of settling's S4 modal closure; generates order by the addition of antisymmetry.

carrier.description: the underlying set the relation ranges over

relation.description: a single binary relation ≤ : carrier × carrier

reflexive.description: a ≤ a for every a (the S4 T axiom of the closure)

transitive.description: a ≤ b and b ≤ c imply a ≤ c (the S4 4 axiom)
